title: Контроль якості представлення
fields_and_relations: Точна revision, очікуване/фактичне, технічні виміри, докази та outcome.

implementation.view_model: Exact representation revision QC, completeness/order/hash facts, explicit readability/parameters, recapture task and evidence
limitations: Waveform/image technical analyzers are not implemented.
Formal pass currently targets plan-based digitization; receipt-only resources retain unknown expected completeness.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 3; incremental migration preserves prior user changes
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
